This design targets Azure in UK South. It has 4 components.

Requests arrive from the public internet and pass through Front Door + WAF, App Service and Cache for Redis.

Compute: App Service.

Network: Front Door + WAF.

Storage: Cache for Redis and PostgreSQL.

Needs confirming before this becomes code: Cache for Redis — Cache SKU and size were not specified in the prompt. PostgreSQL — Compute tier is ambiguous — confirm sizing before generating.
